verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly touches multi-item operations. Sidekick can recommend stock transfers between locations and create them automatically, and Quick counts and incoming-shipment receiving use a barcode scanner to update stock quantities. POS extensions can call the GraphQL Admin API, which suggests programmatic routes, but none of this is documented as bulk editing or bulk actions across many items. Missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/bulk action capability in POS, documented bulk updates of products, prices or inventory, AI-driven bulk operations beyond transfer creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
